issue.title: Retire gate_shell_handoff
issue.description: A /sase_questions or /sase_plan gate becomes a gate shell in the asking agent's family: the asking agent ends as DONE, the gate shell owns the QUESTION/TALE status, and answering it launches the follow-up agent.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Both migrations have soaked and the plan and question flows have been exercised end to end on the enabled branch.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: The asking agent stays alive and blocks in wait_for_gate until the gate settles, then continues in-process as its own successor.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: A /sase_questions or /sase_plan gate becomes a gate shell in the asking agent's family: the asking agent ends as DONE, the gate shell owns the QUESTION/TALE status, and answering it launches the follow-up agent.

payload.entry: Flag removed: the gate-shell handoff path is unconditional, the registry definition is gone, and no live FeatureFlag.gate_shell_handoff references remain.
